require "json"
begin
  entry = JSON.parse('{"minutes":15}')
  value = entry.is_a?(Hash) ? entry["minutes"] : nil
  if value.is_a?(Integer) && (1..60).cover?(value)
    puts value
  else
    puts "invalid shape"
  end
rescue JSON::ParserError
  puts "invalid JSON"
end

require "optparse"
minutes = nil
parser = OptionParser.new do |options|
  options.on("--minutes N", Integer) { |value| minutes = value }
end
begin
  parser.parse!(ARGV)
  if ARGV.empty? && minutes && (1..60).cover?(minutes)
    puts minutes
  else
    puts "invalid minutes"
  end
rescue OptionParser::ParseError
  puts "invalid option"
end
